title: West Drayton Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical, urgent care, and local readiness help points in West Drayton.
content: For immediate life-threatening emergencies, call 999 or 112 right away. 1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals: Hillingdon Hospital (Pield Heath Road, Uxbridge UB8 3NN) — 24-hour A&E. Travel from West Drayton station: ~2 miles north; ~35 min walk north along Station Road, High Street, and Colham Green Road, or take bus 222 or U5 north towards Uxbridge (~10-15 mins). Nearest Major Trauma Centre is St Mary's Hospital (Praed Street, Paddington W2 1NY). 2. NHS Urgent Treatment Centres: Hillingdon Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre (co-located at Hillingdon Hospital, Pield Heath Road UB8 3NN) — open 24 hours daily for urgent illnesses, cuts, sprains, and minor burns. 3. Local Hazard Notes: West Drayton is bounded by multiple watercourses including the River Colne, River Pinn, Wraysbury River, Fray's River, and the Grand Union Canal. Low-lying western areas near Thorney and the Colne Valley regional park face elevated fluvial and surface water flood risks during sustained downpours. 4. Supplies: High Street (Yiewsley) and Station Road contain major supermarkets and dispensing chemists supplying basic first-aid items, sanitary supplies, and bottled water. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
